description: 국토교통부_도로 공사정보 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 건설사업정보시스템(CALS)은 도로 건설사업의 기획부터 설계, 시공, 유지관리에 이르는 전 과정에서 발생하는 각종 정보와 문서를 전산망을 통해 교환·공유하는 통합 정보화 시스템입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 건설사업정보화, 사업동향, 사업개요, 공사, 정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
